label: miso 170 sitegrain
definition: miso-170 ARM-2: lay-up membership correction, site-grain reliability exclusion stamp per PREREG-miso170 §7 amendment (the K-1 repair: census sites excluded from every limb their tranches occupy, incl. Burlington's CT_PEAKER)
market_story: ST_GAS: MISO's merchant steamers run because local reliability and self-commitment keep them synchronized - the measured per-plant online windows and p25 operating levels reproduce that - but a station in economic lay-up has left that population: its owner has mothballed the site, the market clears without it, and no floor may manufacture its energy. The CAMPD facility meter identifies those sites (median output zero in every 4-hour block of every year), and at SITE grain: Burlington (IA)'s combustion turbines are as dark as its steamers - the facility metered zero in 98.7% of the very hours the Plains CT evening limb had floored them - so the census excludes every unit at the site from every operating floor, on the same meter evidence in every class. What remains floored is the population that actually runs: the Entergy-belt VLR steamers at their measured levels, and the one genuine cycler the census refuses to absorb (Little Gypsy, whose pooled-window over-commitment is an honest open defect, not a membership case).
